name: mcode_configure_actions
description: Write a GitHub Actions workflow into .github/workflows/<filename> in the workspace, optionally committing it. filename must be a bare *.yml name. workflow_yaml is the full YAML. Set commit=true to also commit (a later mcode_git push activates it — the GitHub App carries workflows:write). Requires write scope.

workflow_yaml.description: Full YAML contents of the workflow.

commit.description: Also commit the workflow file (default false).
